subject: Role coverage gap prioritization for QBR — emergency req clearances
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Role coverage gap prioritization for QBR — emergency req clearances

Team —

Quick summary: as we pushed the QBR draft into exec review this morning the product leadership flagged three role gaps that materially impact our ability to commit to the OKR delivery dates for the next quarter. I pulled a coverage matrix (attached) that shows current owners, expected ramp, and downstream features impacted.

Asking: can we confirm which of the listed reqs we can (a) escalate for immediate recruiter support and exception to the hiring freeze, (b) hold, or (c) de-scope from the roadmap for Q2? I added an urgent column for freeze-exception candidates.

Immediate constraints: budget gating for reserved headcount is tomorrow (Tue) EOD; the QBR readout is Friday and execs want a concrete plan that does not rely on optimistic hiring timelines.

Please reply with one of the three options and a short justification. If you approve escalation, I will kick off the exception form and loop in Greenwave.

Attachments: role_coverage_matrix.xlsx, qbr-readout-deltas.pdf

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Role coverage gap prioritization for QBR — emergency req clearances

Jordan — thanks for the matrix. I reviewed the three flagged roles:

- Senior Infra Engineer (Core Serving): escalate for immediate exception. This one is blocking a latency lock before QBR; we cannot reasonably de-scope without impacting the SLAs asked of us.
- Staff Data Engineer (Observability): hold. We can mitigate with contractors for the quarter and re-evaluate at mid-Q2.
- PM, Model Lifecycle: consider de-scope to M2 in the roadmap if we cannot get an offer accepted by week 3.

I approve escalation for the Infra role. Please start the req-exception flow and include a cost delta for spot contractor coverage.

Soojín
Soojín Lee
VP, Product Operations
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Sarah Green <sarah.green@greenwave-talent.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role coverage gap prioritization for QBR — emergency req clearances

Thanks Soojín — looping Sarah from Greenwave to stand up immediate search for Senior Infra Engineer. Sarah, can you confirm earliest interview slate and whether you have candidates with low notice windows? Also attaching the exception form we will submit to finance.

[Attachment: req-exception-form.docx]

Next steps (my plan):
1) Sarah to provide candidate slate by Wed 4/14 EOD.
2) Vanessa to confirm budget gating escape (internal) by Tue 4/13 EOD.
3) I will prep a 2-slide QBR appendix showing mitigations if hiring slips.

If anyone wants to push more aggressively (e.g., relocation allowance, bonus), flag now so we can include in the approval ask.

—Jordan
From: Sarah Green <sarah.green@greenwave-talent.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role coverage gap prioritization for QBR — emergency req clearances

Jordan & team —

We ran a light market sweep and have 4 candidates with infra-serving experience who can start with 2–6 weeks notice. Two are local (no relocation), two require 3–4 week notice but are willing to negotiate start dates. I recommend we move to immediate interviews for the top two.

ETA to present full slates and CVs: Wed 4/14 16:00 PT.

Notes: to shorten notice time we can propose a sign-on + flexible start. If finance wants to limit sign-on, we should still be able to secure one candidate in the 4-week window.

—Sarah
Greenwave Talent (recruiting partner)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Sarah Green <sarah.green@greenwave-talent.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role coverage gap prioritization for QBR — emergency req clearances

Confirmed: finance will entertain a one-time freeze exception for critical infra roles if the hiring manager signs off and the req-exception form includes projected impact to Q2 OKRs and an explicit cost contingency. I have asked FP&A to reserve a small buffer; final approval contingent on the HRREQ ticket and sign-off from Markus.

Vanessa
VP, Finance (People Ops partner)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role coverage gap prioritization for QBR — emergency req clearances

Approved for escalation: I have signed off on the req-exception form and updated HRREQ-7812. Please proceed with interviews and get me an offer recommendation ASAP (target: no later than Tue 4/20). If recruiting needs a counteroffer band, coordinate with Vanessa.

For the QBR slides: Jordan, include the candidate timeline and a fallback slide that maps which OKRs would be delayed and the specific mitigation (contractor coverage + reduced scope). We need clear tradeoffs in the readout.

—Markus Klein
Head of Product Strategy
